title: Provider feed index v1 (feed/v1/index.json)
description: Signed by the provider (index.json.sigstore.json). Consumers reject an index that is expired, whose version is lower than one already seen (rollback), or whose provider/predicateType does not match the registry.

version.description: Strictly increasing per publish (e.g. unix seconds).

expires.description: At most 30 days after generatedAt; republish before it passes.

verdict.description: Hint for listing only; consumers use the verdict inside the verified statement.

path.description: Feed-relative path of the attestation: a Sigstore bundle (*.sigstore.json) or, for unsigned dev providers, the bare statement (*.json).

sha256.description: Digest of the file at `path`; binds the attestation to this signed index.
